title: Baobab-Platform product and subscription domain identifiers and enumerations
description: Canonical identifiers and enumerations for Product, ProductVersion, ProductSubscription and EntitlementProjection (Technical Specification SS31, SS88, SS91). This package defines vocabulary only; baobab-platform/baobab-cp is the runtime authority that persists, evaluates and materialises these concepts into CapabilityGrant records.

productVersionId.description: Control Plane-minted opaque identifier for a ProductVersion. Never derived from product_id or the version string.

subscriptionId.description: Control Plane-minted opaque identifier for a ProductSubscription.

entitlementProjectionId.description: Control Plane-minted opaque identifier for an EntitlementProjection row.

productVersionSemver.description: Semantic version of a ProductVersion. Published versions are immutable; a change is a new version, never an in-place edit (mirrors ADR-BCP-005 SS114's rule for CapabilityComposition).

productLifecycle.description: Operational lifecycle of a Product or ProductVersion. Deliberately the same five values as capability/v1/domain.schema.json's capabilityLifecycle -- the concept is identical -- but declared locally rather than cross-referenced, since Product is not itself a Capability.

subscriptionSource.description: How a ProductSubscription came to exist. Distinct from, but the usual origin cited by, capability/v1's capabilityGrantSource=PRODUCT_SUBSCRIPTION source_reference.

entitlementProjectionStatus.description: Whether a subscription-to-capability-grant expansion row has been turned into a real CapabilityGrant yet.

subscriptionType.description: Commercial classification of a ProductSubscription: the ADR-BCP-005 vocabulary, identical to admission/v1 subscriptionType (ADR-SHARED-011). There is no INTERNAL_GROUP. INTERNAL means zero monetary charge, never zero governance: it still grants through ProductVersion -> CapabilityComposition -> CapabilityGrant, and stays metered, audited, readiness- and isolation-controlled.

classificationSource.description: Where a subscription classification came from. ADMISSION_DECISION: the classification_reference is the admission/v1 admission_decision_id. RECLASSIFICATION: a governed change of an existing subscription's classification. MIGRATION: carried over from a pre-existing system. MANUAL_GOVERNANCE: an explicit governed administrative decision.

subscriptionClassificationId.description: Control Plane-minted opaque identifier for one SubscriptionClassificationRecord.

monetaryCharge.description: Whether a subscription type carries a monetary platform charge.

paymentExecution.description: Whether billing a subscription of this type may require payment execution through baobab-payments.
